facts.text: A haul truck is a very large off-road dump truck that carries rock or ore from the excavation location to a dumping or processing location.
facts.quote: A haul truck is a very large off-road dump truck that carries rock or ore from where it is dug to where it is dumped or processed.

facts.text: Most haul trucks have a single stiff frame and are therefore also called rigid dump trucks.
facts.quote: Most have a single stiff frame, so they are also called rigid dump trucks.

facts.text: The largest haul trucks, often called ultra-class trucks, carry roughly 300 t or more.
facts.quote: The largest, often called ultra-class trucks, carry roughly 300 t or more

facts.text: The Caterpillar 797F quoted in the booklet has a 363 t payload and about 624 t gross weight.
facts.quote: the booklet quotes a Caterpillar 797F with a 363 t payload and about 624 t gross weight [Chapter 8]

facts.text: A haul-truck operator sits high up in a cab on one side of the truck.
facts.quote: The operator sits high up in a cab on one side.

facts.text: The front-right blind area of a 50 t haul truck extends 18 m or more and grows with truck size; haul trucks have huge blind areas because they are tall and long.
facts.quote: Because the truck is so tall and long, its blind areas are huge: the front-right blind area of a 50 t haul truck extends 18 m or more and grows with size [Chapter 4].

facts.text: Of 54 US haul-truck deaths from 2005 to mid-2021, 21 involved berms, 13 were collisions with people or vehicles, 12 happened at dump points, and 8 had other causes.
facts.quote: In 54 US haul-truck deaths from 2005 to mid-2021, 21 involved berms, 13 were collisions with people or vehicles, 12 happened at dump points and 8 had other causes.

facts.text: Of the 13 collision deaths in the US haul-truck fatality evidence covering 2005 to mid-2021, 12 involved a truck moving forward.
facts.quote: Of the 13 collisions, 12 involved a truck moving forward

facts.text: Four of the 13 collision deaths in the US haul-truck fatality evidence covering 2005 to mid-2021 began with a truck starting to move while people were within about 15 m.
facts.quote: four began with a truck starting to move while people were within about 15 m [Chapter 4]

facts.text: On long downhill roads, haul trucks slow mainly with a retarder, a braking effect from the drivetrain.
facts.quote: On long downhill roads they slow mainly with a retarder, a braking effect from the drivetrain

facts.text: Haul-truck retarder power is limited, so available deceleration falls as speed and mass rise.
facts.quote: whose power is limited, so available deceleration falls as speed and mass rise [Chapter 8]

facts.text: The booklet identifies haul trucks as having the clearest fatality evidence and identifies forward motion or starting from rest, rather than reversing, as their deadliest pattern.
facts.quote: The haul truck has the clearest fatality evidence, and its deadliest pattern is forward motion or starting from rest, not reversing.

facts.text: The haul-truck validation plan needs separate forward, reverse, start-from-rest, turning and swing scenarios rather than one generic proximity zone.
facts.quote: The plan therefore needs separate forward, reverse, start-from-rest, turning and swing scenarios rather than one generic proximity zone [Chapter 4].
